content:
emma (finance): Heads up team: on 2026-06-01 UTC were changing metering attribution so bursty traffic is recorded in minute buckets instead of daily-averaged lines. No change to unit prices.

jon (billing): What this means: invoices will show minute-level line items (field: minute_bucket_ts). For throttling well still use a 1-hour smoothing window.

lina (ops): Reason: short spikes were hiding cost signal. This helps routing, fair-share policies, and makes invoices reflect real traffic.

emma (finance): Customer impact highlights: free credits are applied per-minute now (so heavy minutes can consume credits quickly). Promo credits issued before 2025-12-31 will have a 90-day roll-forward then expire; support will notify affected accounts.

sam (support): Canned reply: "We now attribute usage to the minute it occurred; spikes may appear. We can review invoices or enable legacy smoothing temporarily."

jon (billing): Dev notes: billing events add minute_bucket_ts and peak_flag. CSV export: customer_id,minute_bucket_ts,tokens,route,model,unit_price_usd. Well ship a console toggle for legacy smoothing for 90 days after launch.

billing-bot: deploy:billing-metering-service v2.14 promoted at 2167000200  minute_bucket_ts ON.

emma (finance): Rollout steps: blog + support article, console banner, customer emails, telemetry review after one week. DM me or tag @jon for contractual exceptions.

sam (support): Adding playbook entries now.
